summary_zh: 本影片介紹「"乱七八糟“」在英文中的多種地道表達方式，幫助學習者擺脫中式英文，掌握母語者常用的自然說法。

vocabulary.example: This is a very useful English expression for '"乱七八糟“'.

example_sentences.en: Native speakers often express '"乱七八糟“' differently than learners expect.
